items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know the Landrys that played music back in the old age? [INTERVIEWEE] Landry.

ctx.x: You know, we must have been fixed up, we had five or sixty. Dime banks. Oh, Dime banks. What about the Landrys?
Did you know the Landrys that played music back in the old age?
